coverage_gaps.suggested_test_intent: Design a test that explicitly requires the director agent to call update_single_airtable_record with valid arguments (e.g., updating a specific record field) and verify the call succeeds without crashing. This addresses the gap where the tool is registered and covered in requirement tests but has no dedicated coverage-guided test exercising its invocation with valid arguments.

Design a test that explicitly requires the director agent to call get_airtable_records with valid arguments (e.g., fetching records from a specific base/table) and verify the call succeeds without crashing. Although the tool is covered in requirement testsoro and a fuzz test, there is no dedicated coverage-guided test for valid-argument invocation.
